semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in contract processing services for CMP and wafer bonding, which are critical processes in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: D-process provides a comprehensive range of contract processing services focused on chemical mechanical polishing (CMP) and wafer bonding. They cater to both small-scale prototyping and medium-volume production, offering flexible solutions that include measurement services and multi-process operations.
capabilities: Wafer bonding techniques including room temperature bonding and plasma activated bonding
Seed layer formation through sputtering and vapor deposition
Mask fabrication and patterning using wet and dry etching
